resources.string: Optional companion for Trackhop. It connects services that have no open API (YouTube Music, and Amazon Music as an experiment) through the same web interface their players use, so you do not need developer keys. Trackhop only receives your playlists and tracks; the logins themselves stay in this app.

Amazon Music has no open API either, and its official one is reserved to approved partners. This connector uses the web player\'s interface. Sign in here: Amazon may ask twice, first on amazon.com and then on your country\'s site, so complete both and leave the screen open until it closes by itself, which happens as soon as the player has started. Then run the connection test.
Connected as %1$s. Search test returned %2$d tracks.

Sign in on Spotify\'s own page instead of creating a developer app. You type your password only on that page: this app never sees or stores it. What is kept is the session (cookies), encrypted on this phone; Trackhop only receives your playlists and tracks.

Sign in with your Apple ID on music.apple.com instead of paying for the Apple Developer Program. You type your password only on Apple\'s page: this app never sees or stores it. What is kept is the session (cookies), encrypted on this phone; Trackhop only receives the web player\'s tokens.

This is not an official Google API. Using it is against the YouTube Terms of Service, it can stop working whenever Google changes something, and in the worst case Google could restrict the account you sign in with. Use it at your own risk, ideally with an account you can afford to lose. The official route (your own Google Cloud key) remains available in Trackhop.

Google has blocked this network address for unusual traffic. The block lifts by itself a few minutes after the requests stop: the Bridge pauses all YouTube Music calls and tells Trackhop how long to wait. If Google\'s page offers a verification, completing it here lifts the block at once.
Your session is stored encrypted on this phone only. It is never sent to Trackhop, to its developer or to anyone else.
